title: HEALING SLOWS AND BIG HITS INTERRUPT
why: His g-2 answer: Half speed. His g-5 answer: Only a big hit stops it. Watch: healing in the open gets riskier; check whether the 1.5 s half-speed wind-up feels sticky, whether the slow should continue through healing (4.2 s bandage, 9.6 s medkit), and whether losing the item to a big hit feels too harsh.
now: Medical wind-ups move at half speed without sprint. A landed incoming hit of 30 or more cancels the wind-up and spends the item. Plates and flowing heals keep their rules.
